introHtml: Poly propylene aprons are a practical choice for businesses that need lightweight, fluid-resistant protection. Unlike cotton or canvas, these aprons repel liquids and are easy to wipe clean, making them ideal for food prep, janitorial staff, or lab environments. They can be screen-printed with your logo for a crisp, professional look that holds up to repeated use. Order bulk custom poly propylene aprons to keep your team uniformed and safe.
